name: Chladni Patterns
desc: A resonating plate whose sand grains stochastically migrate onto shifting nodal lines as parametric (m,n) modes drift and step, in sand, brass, sumi-ink, blueprint-contour and thermal false-color renderings.

complexity.doc: mode magnitude m,n (finer nodal pattern at max)

style.doc: render philosophy: pale grains on dark plate / warm metallic / sumi ink on washi / blueprint nodal-contour lines / heat false-color field

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: hold+converge / modes climb ever finer / plate rings on the beat
